mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.name, p.slug, p.description, p.ingredients, p.storage_guide, p.ocop_star, p.ocop_certificate_no, p.story, p.approval_status, p.listing_status, p.approved_by, p.approved_at, p.version, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.name AS category_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND p.listing_status = 'ACTIVE'

sql.if: AND ( p.name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.slug ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.product_id = p.id AND pv.sku_code ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ) )

AND ( p.name ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR p.description ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.product_id = p.id AND pv.sku_code ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' ) )

mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE 1=1

SELECT p.listing_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM products p WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY p.listing_status

SELECT DISTINCT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY c.name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( id, category_id, name, slug, description, ingredients, storage_guide, ocop_star, ocop_certificate_no, story, approval_status, listing_status, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{slug}, #{description}, #{ingredients}, #{storageGuide}, #{ocopStar}, #{ocopCertificateNo}, #{story}, #{approvalStatus}::approval_status, #{listingStatus}::listing_status, #{version}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, slug = #{slug}, description = #{description}, ingredients = #{ingredients}, storage_guide = #{storageGuide}, ocop_star = #{ocopStar}, ocop_certificate_no = #{ocopCertificateNo}, story = #{story}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE products SET approval_status = #{approvalStatus}::approval_status, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_at = CASE WHEN #{approvalStatus} = 'APPROVED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
